verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developer.navan.com, framed for connecting AI assistants via MCP. The developer portal also has agent-oriented MCP documentation with example natural-language queries and capability lists, giving an agent a clear entry point.
